test_sgd_optimizer: test the sgd optimizer with learning rate 0.01 and verify parameter update after applying gradients
test_adam_optimizer: test the adam optimizer with learning rate 0.01 and verify optimizer state contains step plus m and v per parameter
test_adam_variable_lr: test the adam optimizer with a variable learning rate that is either trainable or non-trainable
create_optimizer_sgd: create an sgd optimizer using optimizers.optimizer wrapper with snt.optimizers.SGD and a learning rate
create_optimizer_adam: create an adam optimizer using optimizers.optimizer wrapper with snt.optimizers.Adam and a learning rate
